content.bridge_context: We learn to organize information (Data) and represent it visually using Pictographs—where pictures represent numbers.

units.title: Data Collection
units.explanation: Gathering information through observation or questioning (e.g., favorite fruits of students).

units.title: Pictographs
units.explanation: A way of showing data using images. A key is used to define the value of each image.
units.dual_language_instruction: Read the pictograph. / चित्रालेख को पढ़ें।
